cues.en: Mike: This video describes an unsupervised learning challenge.
cues.zh: 這部影片說明一個「非監督式學習」挑戰。

cues.en: It's a little bit of a pun that I'm calling these exercises unsupervised learning.
cues.zh: 把這些練習叫做非監督式學習，是個小雙關。

cues.en: It's not the machine learning algorithm for unsupervised learning, but it means that I'm going to assign you a problem.
cues.zh: 不是機器學習中的非監督式學習演算法，而是我會指派一個問題。

cues.en: I'm going to explain what you should do, but I'm not going to give you my solution.
cues.zh: 會解釋應該做什麼，但不提供我的解法。

cues.en: It's up to you to come up with a solution on your own.
cues.zh: 你要自行想出答案。

cues.en: So that's what I mean by unsupervised learning.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡非監督式學習的意思。

cues.en: Okay, so in the previous, or I guess it was two videos ago in the slides about the histogram, I told you the formula
cues.zh: 前一部，或者應該是前兩部的直方圖投影片中，介紹過公式，

cues.en: for converting a histogram from counts into proportion.
cues.zh: 把次數直方圖轉成比例直方圖。

cues.en: So what I want you to do here now in this code challenge is to modify the code that you see here somehow
cues.zh: 這個程式挑戰，我要你設法修改這裡的程式碼，

cues.en: to convert these histograms into proportion on the y axis instead of raw counts on the Y axis.
cues.zh: 把y軸從原始次數，轉成比例。

cues.en: Now, on the one hand, you can actually do this as an optional input into histogram, so you can provide some additional input, I'm not gonna tell you what it is, and get histogram to do the conversion for you,
cues.zh: 其實可以在histogram提供選用輸入，多加某個參數，我不告訴你是什麼，讓histogram替你轉換，

cues.en: but please don't do that.
cues.zh: 但請不要那樣做。

cues.en: I don't want you to do that.
cues.zh: 我不希望你那樣做。

cues.en: I want you to figure this out on your own.
cues.zh: 希望你自行想出來。

cues.en: I want you to look up that formula that I showed you and apply that formula to convert these Y axis values, you'll have to use the output of hist or the output
cues.zh: 找出我展示的公式，套用它，轉換這些y軸值。必須使用hist的輸出，或，

cues.en: of hist counts.
cues.zh: histcounts的輸出。

cues.en: So convert the y axis values, the heights of these bars into proportion.
cues.zh: 把y軸值，也就是長條高度，轉成比例。

cues.en: And if you solved it correctly, then you'll make two observations.
cues.zh: 如果正確解答，會觀察到兩件事。

cues.en: One observation is that the shape of the distribution is exactly the same for histogram counts versus proportion.
cues.zh: 第一，次數直方圖與比例直方圖的分布形狀，完全相同。

cues.en: And the second observation is that the sum of all of the proportion values, the sum of all the Y values must add up to either one
cues.zh: 第二，所有比例值、所有y值的總和，必須等於1，

cues.en: if you're doing proportion, or 100 if you're doing percent.
cues.zh: 如果用比例；或等於100，如果用百分比。

cues.en: Either one is fine.
cues.zh: 任一種都可以。

cues.en: So you can do this in MATLAB if you're working in MATLAB or you do it in Python if you prefer working in Python, it doesn't matter which language you use.
cues.zh: 用MATLAB就寫MATLAB，偏好Python就寫Python，使用哪種語言都沒關係。

cues.en: So I hope you enjoy working through this code challenge.
cues.zh: 希望你享受完成這個程式挑戰的過程。

cues.en: If you get stuck or if you have some really beautiful graph that you want to share, please post the Q&A.
cues.zh: 如果卡住，或有非常漂亮的圖想分享，請在問與答發文。

cues.en: I really enjoy seeing other people's solutions to these code challenges.
cues.zh: 我很喜歡看其他人對這些程式挑戰的解法。
